title: FileDrop
description: A file picker and dropzone with one row per file: size, upload progress, done, and remove / retry on failure. Controlled: the app owns the list and does the upload.
when: Choosing or dropping one or more files: CSV import, product photos, invoices, firmware, model files.
Showing the progress of each upload and letting the user retry or remove a file.
Duplicates (same name and size as an item or earlier in the batch) and dropped folders are rejected too: onReject reasons are type, size, directory, duplicate, multiple.

instead.need: A single progress bar not tied to files
A long blocking job after the files are sent

instead.use: A Button that opens the picker, with the preview next to it

a11y: The drop area is a real button: Enter / Space open the file picker, with a visible focus ring.
Inside a Field it takes the id, aria-describedby and invalid state; its label names the button.
Added, rejected and failed files are announced in a polite live region; each progress bar and remove button names its file.

examples.title: Import with validation
examples.description: accept and maxSize filter files; rejected ones go to onReject, which here feeds the Field error.

examples.title: Row states
examples.description: Done, uploading (determinate and indeterminate), error with Retry, and a disabled drop area.

examples.title: One file
examples.description: Without multiple, only the first valid file is added; the rest go to onReject with reason "multiple".
